items.title: Hisense Fridge 250L
items.description: Excellent condition double-door fridge/freezer, only three years old and still under a transferable warranty. Runs quietly, seals are perfect and the interior has been deep cleaned. Ideal for a family of four.

items.title: 3-Seater Fabric Couch
items.description: Charcoal fabric couch with removable, washable covers. Two small marks on the left armrest (shown in the second photo), otherwise structurally solid with no sagging.

items.title: Queen Bed Base & Mattress
items.description: Sealy queen base and mattress set, always used with a protector so the mattress is spotless. Includes the original headboard brackets.

items.title: Solid Pine Study Desk
items.description: Sturdy pine desk with two drawers and a cable cut-out at the back. Some pen marks on the surface that sand out easily.

items.title: Defy 30L Microwave
items.description: Large-capacity microwave with grill function. Turntable and manual included.

items.title: Samsung 8kg Washing Machine
items.description: Front loader with EcoBubble, recently serviced with a new door seal. Inlet and drain hoses included.

items.title: 55" Samsung Smart TV
items.description: 4K smart TV with two remotes and the original wall bracket. Screen is unmarked; no dead pixels.

items.title: Ryobi Electric Lawnmower
items.description: 1600W electric mower with a 40L grass box and adjustable cutting height. Blade sharpened at the end of last season.

items.title: Oak Bookshelf (5 Shelves)
items.description: Solid oak veneer bookshelf, 1.8 m tall. Comes with the anti-tip wall strap.

items.title: Dining Table & 4 Chairs
items.description: Six-seater table with four matching upholstered chairs. Two extra chairs are available separately — ask when you message.
